reason: The hypothesis combines two distinct treatments—low-temperature plasma oxy-nitriding and laser surface texturing—that have been studied separately in the literature (P5, P12, P21, P24 for oxy-nitriding; P1, P10, P13 for nitriding+texturing) but have not been applied together on TC4. The specific sequence (oxy-nitriding first, then texturing) and the rationale that the porous oxy-nitrided layer will interact with the laser-induced microtexturing to balance hardness and toughness is not stated in any passage. This integration of findings from different papers into a single proposal with a stated mechanism goes beyond the individual sources.
